dataset-of-origin.detail: Multi-site rsfMRI data from 25 research sites provided via REST-meta-MDD consortium
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "The imaging datasets for MDD used in this study were sourced from the REST-meta-MDD consortium (http://rfmri.org/RESTmeta-MDD) [31, 32]. These data include rsfMRI data from 25 research sites, comprising 1276 MDD patients"

age.detail: Mean and SD taken from Table 1 (36.23 ± 14.62). Note: the in-text description reports SD as 21.38, which appears to be a typographic error; Table 1 is used as the primary source. Age range (min/max) not reported.

sex.detail: Males directly reported as 463 (36.29%). Females estimated as 1276 − 463 = 813 (63.71%); estimation noted.
